description: "Practical Boat-Sailing: A Concise and Simple Treatise" by Douglas Frazar is a comprehensive guide on the management of small boats and yachts written in the late 19th century. The book primarily aims to instruct readers on handling and maneuvering boats safely, covering essential skills such as understanding sail configurations, anchoring techniques, and emergency procedures.
